description: Amendments to planning permission dated 23rd December 2024 (RN: 24/04744/FULL) for Variation of conditions 1, 28, 31, 32, 36, 37 and 42 of planning permission dated 19th January 2024 (RN 23/01690/FULL) for the Part demolition, remodelling and extension of existing part eight and part four storey building plus basement (Use Class E, with former caretaker unit) to create an eight-storey building plus basement and roof level plant (Use Class E) and new facade, relocation of main entrance to side facade, new landscaped garden space, roof terraces, waste storage, cycle parking, associated plant and other necessary works. Namely, Gillingham Street gate and ninth floor roof terrace railings, modifications to basement, improved refuse strategy, additional area required for plant. Elevation changes following opening up, accommodating edge beams, omission of recessed panels, MEP coordination, material changes, consistent material composition. Undercroft, replacement of timber soffit identified as unsuitable for a designated escape route, cafe reorientated to encourages footfall into the undercroft and garden entrance extended into the undercroft, structural columns relocated to the boundary to open up views towards the garden, façade simplified to improve views in and out, opening between ground and first floors was aligned with the undercroft
